method: Read current public official pricing, product, policy, and documentation pages. Review date is not the publication date of every source. No checkout, private quote, or network measurement was performed.

facts: Free $0/month; Pro $25 monthly or $20/month annually; Business $250 monthly or $200/month annually; Contract custom annual pricing.
Free, Pro, and Business video or disproportionate large-file delivery can trigger action without an appropriate paid service.
Recommended video options are Stream and Enterprise Stream Delivery.
500 Tbps total provisioned external interconnection capacity, not peak delivered traffic.

corrections: Removed unsupported $5,000+ Enterprise entry price; added monthly versus annual prices.
Replaced the unsupported general APAC-routing statement with editorial advice to test visitor networks.
limits: The April capacity announcement is historical; a newer equivalent capacity figure was not established.

facts: $1/month minimum; no request fees; 14-day trial without credit card.
Standard rates: EU/NA 0.01, Asia/Oceania 0.03, South America 0.045, ME/Africa 0.06 USD/GB.
Volume: first 500 TB 0.005, 500 TB–1 PB 0.004, 1–2 PB 0.002 USD/GB; above 2 PB contact sales.
119 Standard and 10 Volume PoPs.
Same Standard and first two Volume prices, but 1–2 PB is 0.003 USD/GB.
Volume explicitly supports video streaming, software delivery, and large downloads.
250+ Tbps global backbone; Standard and Volume location list.

conflicts: Official marketing pricing says $0.002/GB for 1–2 PB; official documentation says $0.003/GB. No single definitive price was established for this band.
corrections: Removed the definitive 1–2 PB rate from display; pricing verification is partial.
limits: Do not extrapolate an exact Volume estimate above 1 PB until the conflicting prices are resolved.
The reviewed table labels do not explicitly establish whether volume discounts apply marginally or retroactively to all monthly traffic.

facts: CDN PAYG €0/month with 1 TB/month included, then €0.01/GB; VAT excluded.
Requests over 1 billion billed €0.75 per million; Enterprise custom.
PAYG lists basic L3/L4 DDoS; WAAP and live streaming are on-demand.
210+ PoPs, 200+ Tbps; live and VOD delivery supported.
General FAQ says L3/L4/L7 and next-gen WAF across all plans.

conflicts: General product FAQ says L7/WAF included across all plans, while the pricing table lists basic L3/L4 and WAAP on-demand. Display uses the specific pricing-table scope.
corrections: Replaced old Free/Start/Pro $37/$105 subscription structure and old overage prices with current PAYG/Enterprise pricing.
Currency is EUR as rendered by the official pricing page; no USD conversion was inferred.
limits: Security inclusion beyond the pricing-table wording requires clarification.

facts: Full Site Delivery: 100 GB and 1 million requests free monthly.
First paid tier to 10 TB: $0.12–0.28/GB; EU/NA $0.12, South Korea $0.28. Next 10 TB: $0.08–0.24/GB.
Requests above 1 million start $0.01/10,000; custom high-volume pricing available.
622 Tbps connected global capacity; Seoul listed.
VOD caching and delivery product available.
Live delivery supports HLS and MPEG-DASH.

corrections: Headline now shows first paid tier rates, instead of presenting the lower next-tier price as the starting rate.
limits: Private enterprise discounts and streaming-specific quoted rates were not established.

facts: Flat-rate monthly plans per distribution: Free $0, Pro $15, Business $200, Premium $1,000.
Free includes 100 GB/1M requests; Pro 50 TB/10M; Business 50 TB/125M; Premium starts 50 TB/500M with higher configurable allowances.
Always Free PAYG allowance: 1 TB transfer and 10M HTTP/HTTPS requests per month.
Bandwidth and request rates vary by region and tier.
No annual commitment or overage fees.
Sustained or unusually large excess use can cause delivery adjustments, including fewer or more distant edges. First spike up to 3x allowance has a one-time accommodation.
750+ PoPs in 100+ cities/50+ countries plus 1,140+ embedded PoPs in 300+ cities within ISP networks.
Supports VOD and live streaming using HTTP origins; encoded/packaged media is required.

conflicts: Some prose examples on the PAYG page mention a 20M request allowance, but its explicit Always Free list and repeated pricing tables use 10M. The entry uses the explicit allowance.
corrections: Made PAYG and flat-rate allowances distinct; included Pro's current 50 TB allowance and flat-rate performance adjustments.
limits: Full regional usage tiers and optional features are not represented by a single headline rate.

trial.fact: Trial ends after 14 days or credit exhaustion: $20 without a card, $50 with a card.

volumeBilling.finding: No explicit marginal-versus-whole-usage discount method established. Exact calculator estimates stop above 500 TB; 1–2 PB rates also conflict.

maintainerPricingNote.statement: Enterprise starts at about $5,000/month, according to the maintainer.
maintainerPricingNote.basis: Direct user correction; experience/opinion, not an official public minimum.
